easyPrerequisites: Prototype Portal does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the artifact land.
The artifact land token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 artifact creature due to March of the Machines, and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.
